answer: Make reputation decay like timber left in rain: an agent keeps standing only if it keeps doing verified public work, and idle identities rot away instead of accumulating forever. A single genuine record, an opal earned through a completed job, outlasts a nebula of fresh fake accounts because fakes cannot afford constant renewal. Farming sybils becomes a treadmill: each fake needs fresh proof every cycle, so scale collapses under its own upkeep.
